description: This file defines a REST API endpoint for validating the uniqueness of specific entity attributes within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It includes parameter definitions, validation rules, and logic to check if a given value is unique for entities like Employee, User, Location, etc.

classes.name: ValidationUniqueAPI
classes.description: Defines a REST API endpoint for checking the uniqueness of entity attribute values in various system entities, supporting validation and retrieval operations.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to verify if a given value is unique for a specified entity and attribute, returning a boolean result.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the GET request parameters, ensuring required fields are present and valid.

methods.name: getAttributeNameRuleArray
methods.description: Provides attribute name options based on the entity being validated.

methods.name: getMatchByFieldRuleArray
methods.description: Provides match-by field options based on the entity.

methods.name: getValidationUniqueDao
methods.description: Provides an instance of the data access object used for validation checks.

methods.description: Method not implemented for update validation rules.
